headline: every score carries an interval resampled by game week
detail: a bet is not independent of the other bets in its game, so the interval resamples whole weeks

headline: the family of strategies is finite and declared before scoring
detail: seven registrations; a familywise correction is applied the moment two or more are scored

headline: a market-following control sits on every row
detail: a strategy that cannot beat taking the close is not skill, it is the market

headline: Brier against the de-vigged close; no ROI ranking
detail: a return on a small sample is noise with a sign; the desk does not rank on it

headline: 4,721 bets to separate a 52% bet from a 50% one at 80% power
detail: computed from the observed variance of the de-vigged close, not a rule of thumb
